messages:
sarah: deploy-bot just flagged a canary failure in eu-west1 for obelisk-rc1. Requesting expedited hotfix rollout and pin. Paging @julian @tess for quick approvals. Short summary below.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary check failed - 5xx rate spike > 2% over 5m. Route: /v1/generate (eu-west1). Artifact: obelisk-rc1. Canary job: canary-e2e FAILED.

deploy-bot: ```
2026-03-21T12:03:12Z ERROR canary-e2e: tokenizer mismatch on model obelisk-rc1
2026-03-21T12:03:14Z 500 GET /v1/generate 120ms svc=serving-core instance=eu-west1-a-12
2026-03-21T12:03:18Z ALERT 5xx_rate=2.7% window=5m
```

julian: oncall_d — can you confirm scope/impact? any P0 customers hit?

oncall_d: I'm on it. Reproduced 500s on embed-heavy requests from EU shard. Repro: `curl -XPOST https://eu-west1.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` -> 500 with tokenizer error. Looks like quant kernel selection in rc1 compiled without fallback for some tokenizers.

sarah: build note: we shipped a kernel selection tweak in rc1 to prefer int8 kernels; fallback disabled to measure perf. Hotfix = re-enable compat fallback and repin to rc0-like config. Impact: primarily embed/generation routes in eu-west. Estimated customer impact ~<5% traffic in region but still visible errors.

tess: need a rollback plan and brief release note. Also check if any compliance/regulatory data flows are affected (EU customers).

maria: rollback plan ready: 1) pause canary 2) `deploy pin obelisk obelisk-rc0 --region eu-west1` 3) monitor 5m window for 5xx and latency 4) resume traffic. I can run the pin. If rollback fails, manual host restart and restore kernel settings. ETA to complete ~10m once approved.

ravi: infra +1. We've validated rc0 build artifacts; no config drift. Recommending pin and quick validation.

tess: pm signoff: approved. Please include `obelisk-rc1 -> obelisk-rc0` in release notes and mention root cause as kernel selection/quant fallback. :thumbsup:

sarah: security checked - no user data exposure, just runtime errors. No legal hold.

deploy-bot: Executing command: `deploy pin obelisk obelisk-rc0 --region eu-west1 --timeout 600 --by=sarah`

deploy-bot: [ACTION] pin started for obelisk in eu-west1. Pausing canary traffic and pinning nodes.

deploy-bot: ```
2026-03-21T12:08:01Z INFO pin: starting 12 hosts
2026-03-21T12:08:15Z INFO pin: host eu-west1-a-12 -> obelisk-rc0 applied
2026-03-21T12:08:45Z INFO pin: 6/12 hosts complete, monitoring metrics
2026-03-21T12:09:22Z INFO pin: 12/12 hosts complete
```

deploy-bot: Pin complete. Canary paused. Metrics check: 5xx rate dropped from 2.7% -> 0.2% within 90s. Latency stable. Rolling to remaining hosts now.

maria: validated - running smoke tests now (e2e tokenization checks). All green.

julian: thanks team. Any follow-up tasks? Who will file the postmortem if needed?

sarah: I'll file a short postmortem and add remediation to CI to prevent disabling fallback without a canary flag. Also will update the release notes and customer-facing status if needed.

tess: please attach the canary logs and timeline to the release note. Approved for expedited hotfix.

sarah: closing thread — pin rolled, monitoring for 30m. Will reopen if regressions surface. :white_check_mark:
